payload.title: frick CLI in Rust (init/scaffold/dev/dashboard)
payload.description: Rewrite apps/cli as a Rust binary (clap): frick init scaffolds BOTH app modes — a Cargo project embedding frick-server as a library (Rust schema + wiring), and a config-driven project for the standalone server binary. Port dev profiles (e.g. redpanda --dry-run), dashboard serving, schema generate/lint commands, and push-credential management. Single static binary replaces the npm-publish problem noted in apps/cli/README.md.
